name: Mud Cloth
desc: Malian bogolanfini mud cloth — strip-woven cotton dyed dark with fermented mud, hand-painted in bands of bold cream geometry: zigzags, ladders, crosses, concentric diamonds, dot grids and combs, each mark irregular by hand, the ground perpetually deepening in slow mud-development waves as the bolt scrolls.

style.doc: classic brown / high-contrast black / ochre earth / indigo-black / reverse painted brown-on-cream
